items.title: Operation Cyclone: Multi-Account Circular Laundering Ring

CASE-2026-001.title: Operation Cyclone: Multi-Account Circular Laundering Ring

content.description: 4-hop cycle originating and terminating at 8000EBD30 within 18 minutes (volume: 450,000 INR)

content.notes: Snapshot captured with 2 hops highlighting shared hardware device DEV_SHARED_01 between Rajesh Kumar and Amit Sharma

content.text: Cross-referenced KYC documentation for PLANTCYC1 and PLANTCYC2. Both accounts registered using forged Aadhaar cards from the same IP block (103.212.43.19).

tasks.title: Freeze outbound UPI settlements on 8000EBD30 and PLANTCYC1
Request device IMEI trace from telco provider for DEV_SHARED_01
Draft Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) filing for FIU-IND

decisions.rationale: Clear algorithmic cycle topology, zero economic commercial justification, and shared physical device between nominal distinct counterparties confirm coordinated synthetic fraud ring.

CASE-2026-001.summary: Forensic investigation establishes coordinated money laundering via a 4-hop circular routing ring. 450,000 INR was dispatched from account 8000EBD30 (Rajesh Kumar), relayed through mule nodes PLANTCYC1, PLANTCYC2, and PLANTCYC3, and returned to origin in 18 minutes with 2.55% slippage. Hardware device DEV_SHARED_01 was concurrently utilized to authenticate transactions across both originator and intermediary accounts from Bangalore IP 103.212.43.19, conclusively refuting legitimate third-party commerce.

audit.detail: Created case from alerts ALT-2026-0091, ALT-2026-0084
Marked TSK-101 (Freeze outbound settlements) as done
